name: Bellator Shirt Tatton
description:
Stylish, functional, and deadly: the Bellator clothing line is designed to fit in at dinner party just as well as a gunfight. Accompanied by a luxurious silk tie, this shirt provides some combat protection thanks to the intricate weaving of layered graphene into its threads.

The Tatton edition features a pale gray shirt paired with a regal gold and blue striped gray tie.
